Mushure maizvozvo, skani yechipiri yekusarudza — nemagirazi, ndebvu dzakasiyana kana chiedza chimwe — inoita kuti kuzivikanwa kuvimbike zvakanyanya panguva ipi zvayo yezuva.

Snapshots yechiso chako iyo Ubuntu Hello inofananidza inopesana. Chengeta maviri, akarekodhwa muchiedza chakasiyana.

Muenzaniso mumwe chete wechiso wakanyoreswa. Magirazi, kuchinja kwendebvu kana chiedza chakasiyana zvinochinja mataridzire echiso chako kukamera, saka muenzaniso mumwe chete unogona kukundikana (semuenzaniso manheru pasi pemarambi). Wedzera muenzaniso wechipiri nemagirazi kana pasina, chimiro chako chimwe, kana muchiedza chakasiyana kuti kuvhura kurambe kuchivimbika.
Iyo kamera Ubuntu Hello inoshandisa kutsvaga chiso chako, ine mhenyu yekutarisisa.
Chiziviso chedesktop chinoratidza uku Ubuntu Hello ichitsvaga chiso chako, yobva yashuma mhedzisiro. Kutadza kuedza ramba uri muchirongwa chekuzivisa.
Kadhi rimwe pakuedza kwechokwadi kwechiso, rakagadziridzwa panzvimbo nemhedzisiro.
Ridza kurira kwesistimu yekuedza kunozivikanwa kana kukundikana.
Wedzera iyo modhi, chokwadi vs. chikumbaridzo, mafuremu, kamera uye nguva kune yega yega kadhi. Inobatsira pakutaura dambudziko.
Kuti chiso chako chinofanira kuenderana zvakadii, uye kana Ubuntu Hello ichifanira kukukumbira kusimbisa kuti uripo chaizvo.
Kana chiso chako chaenderana, chiziviso chinokukumbira kugutsurira musoro. Mufananidzo wakabatwa pamberi pekamera haugoni kugutsurira musoro.

Gonesa kusimbiswa kwechiso kuti keyring yako yekupinda kana KWallet ivhurwe yega paunopinda. Izvi zvinochengeta password yako zvakachengeteka, yakavharirwa mu TPM kana iripo, kana yakavharidzirwa ne AES-256-GCM uchishandisa kiyi huru ye root chete. Kusimbiswa kwechiso kunoisa PAM_AUTHTOK ye pam_gnome_keyring kana pam_kwallet5 zvichienderana ne desktop yako.
Otomatiki inotevera mutauro wehurongwa. Shanduko dzinoshandiswa pakarepo.

Tapedza! Ubuntu Hello yave kushanda pakombuta iyi. Edza kuita chero chinhu chaungawanzo nyora password yako kuti iite chokwadi, sekumhanyisa rairo ne sudo. Kana iwe wakagonesa keyring auto-unlock, kiyi yako yekupinda kana KWallet inozovhurwa otomatiki pakupinda.

Unogona kuvhura iyo Ubuntu Hello Configurator gare gare kuti uchinje mamwe magadzirirwo epamberi kana kuwedzera mamwe mamodheru. Dzvanya Pedzisa pazasi kuvhara iyi hwindo uye wovhura iyo Ubuntu Hello Configurator.

Nekuda kweshanduko mumakona, chinhambwe, uye zvimwe zvinhu kuenzaniswa kwechiso hakuna kumbobvira kwakafanana neyakachengetwa modhi yechiso. Pane ino peji unogona kuseta kuti Ubuntu Hello inofanira kuomesesa sei.
Kuenderana kusina kuoma uye kunokurumidza kukupinza. Sarudza izvi kana kureruka kuchikosha kupfuura kuoma.
Kuenderana kwakaoma asi kuchiri kukurumidza kukupinza. Kungangotadza kukuziva kana wakatarisa nedivi kana uri kure zvishoma.
Kuenderana kwakanyanya kuoma, pasina danho rekuwedzera paunopinda. Zvinokurudzirwa.
Unogona kuwedzera mamwe mamodheru echiso gare gare kubva mu Settings kana ne: sudo ubuntu-hello add
Tarisa kamera yawakasarudza: kamera infrared inoratidza mwenje diki unopenya uku Ubuntu Hello uchiiedza. Izvi zvinotiudza kana ichigona kuona chiso chako murima.

Ubuntu Hello ichatsvaga yako system otomatiki kune chero anowanikwa kamera, saka ita shuwa kuti webcam yako yakabatana. Mushure mekuona runyoro rwemawebcams anoshanda acharatidzwa. Sarudza yaunoda kushandisa uye tinya Next.
Ubuntu Hello inoda matatu akafanodzidziswa ekuziva kumeso dhata kuti akwanise kukuziva, ayo anozodhaunirodwa izvozvi. Unogona kuona kurodha kufambira mberi pazasi.
Iyi wizard inokufambisa iwe kuburikidza nekuseta uye kugadzirisa otomatiki Ubuntu Hello yako. Dzvanya inotevera kuti uenderere mberi.
Ubuntu Hello inogona kuvhura otomatiki kiyi yako yekupinda kana KWallet uchishandisa humbowo hwechokwadi, kudzivirira password yekukurudzira mushure mekupinda mukati.
